title: Signals from 2086
subtitle: An ordinary day in an extraordinary century.
description: A complete fictional future newspaper with seven original stories, illustrated reporting, section archives, and a local reading list. Borrow a municipal cloud, visit a lunar seed library, and meet the people making an imagined city work.
instruction: Choose a headline to read the full fictional story. Use the section links, save a story for later, or switch to larger type.
